name: AEA High Confidence
expression: (((D:AEA RD-FRD-Admonishment Phrase > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Literal Phrase > 1)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Literal Phrase > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Contextual Phrase > 0)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (High Confidence) > 2) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD Pattern (High Confidence) > 0)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (High Confidence) > 2) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Contextual Phrase > 0)))

name: US PII
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) - High > 4) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0) OR ((D:Date of Birth - High Confidence > 1) AND (D:Drivers License (United States) - High > 4)))

name: Private Keys
expression: ((D:Private Keys-Plaintext Regex > 0) OR (D:JWK Private Key > 0) OR (D:Z-Private keys > 0) OR (D:Encrypted or ASCII Armored PGP Keys > 0) OR (D:Encrypted Bouncy Castle Key Exports > 0))

name: Financial Information
expression: ((D:ABA Bank Routing Number - High > 4) OR (D:ABA Bank Routing Number - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:Credit Cards - High > 4) OR (D:Credit Cards - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:Credit Card Magnetic Tracks > 0) OR (D:ML_TAX_LEAKAGE > 0) OR (D:Form K-1 > 3) OR (D:Form 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC > 4) OR (D:W2 or W4 or W9 Forms > 3) OR (D:Form 1040 and related schedules > 3) OR (D:FINANCIAL > 0) OR (D:ML_CORPORATE_FINANCE_LEAKAGE > 0))

name: US PHI - Medium Confidence
expression: (((D:ML_MEDICAL_DOC_LEAKAGE > 0) OR ((D:MEDICAL > 0) AND ((D:DRUGS_LEAKAGE > 9) OR (D:DISEASES_LEAKAGE > 9)))) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 0) OR (D:US Passport - High Confidence > 0) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 0) OR ((D:Date of Birth - High Confidence > 0) AND (D:Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 0))))

name: US PHI - High Confidence
expression: (((D:ML_MEDICAL_DOC_LEAKAGE > 0) OR ((D:MEDICAL > 0) AND ((D:DRUGS_LEAKAGE > 14) OR (D:DISEASES_LEAKAGE > 14)))) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:US Passport - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR ((D:Date of Birth - Prox 500 > 1) AND (D:Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 1)) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:US Passport - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0)))

name: CUI-Detect-All
description: Full CUI detection surface: banner grammar, category tokens, legacy markings, malformed-marking proximity, and designation blocks.
expression: ((((D:CUI-Banner-Structural > 0) OR (D:CUI-Banner-LDC > 0) OR (D:CUI-PortionMark-Structural > 1) OR (D:CUI-Code-CTI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-PRVCY > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-PROPIN > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-SSEL > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-ISVI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-OPSEC > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-NNPI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-PCII > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-CVI > 0) OR (D:Legacy-FOUO > 0) OR (D:Legacy-LES > 0) OR (D:Legacy-SBU > 0) OR (D:Legacy-Distribution-Statements > 0)) OR ((D:CUI-Prox-EXPT > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-TAX > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-LEI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-CRIT > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-NUC > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-INTEL > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-LEGAL > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-PROCURE > 0) OR (D:CUI-LDC-Standalone > 0) OR (D:CUI-Designation-Indicator > 2) OR (D:CUI-Basic-Bare > 2)))) AND NOT (D:CUI-Decontrol-Context > 0)

name: CUI-Detect-Contextual
description: Content-based CUI signal: three or more distinct marking-guide phrases together with a Registry category name, minus the decontrol exclusion. Monitor only.

name: CUI-Detect-Block-Grade
description: High-precision signals intended to BLOCK (16 dictionaries with their minimum counts), minus the exclusion dictionaries.
expression: (((D:CUI-Banner-Structural > 0) OR (D:CUI-Banner-LDC > 0) OR (D:CUI-PortionMark-Structural > 1) OR (D:CUI-Code-CTI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-PRVCY > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-PROPIN > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-SSEL > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-ISVI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-OPSEC > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-NNPI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-PCII > 0) OR (D:CUI-Code-CVI > 0) OR (D:Legacy-FOUO > 0) OR (D:Legacy-LES > 0) OR (D:Legacy-SBU > 0) OR (D:Legacy-Distribution-Statements > 0))) AND NOT ((D:CUI-Decontrol-Context > 0))

name: CUI-Detect-Caution-Grade
description: Lower-precision signals intended to CAUTION (12 dictionaries with their minimum counts), minus the exclusion dictionaries. Never wire to BLOCK.
expression: (((D:CUI-Basic-Bare > 2) OR (D:CUI-LDC-Standalone > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-EXPT > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-TAX > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-LEI > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-CRIT > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-NUC > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-INTEL > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-LEGAL > 0) OR (D:CUI-Prox-PROCURE > 0) OR (D:CUI-Designation-Indicator > 2) OR (D:CUI-Declassify-Date > 0))) AND NOT ((D:CUI-Decontrol-Context > 0))
